title: Mansell Boat Rentals

services.name: Motorboat Rentals
services.desc: Boating on Mount Desert Island waters from Southwest Harbor to Somes Sound, and the Cranberry Islands is one of the most memorable experiences you will have. There are 17 mountains on the island. Views from the water are spectacular. A short distance from our Manset pier is the Bear Island Lighthouse. Travel north through the Somes Sound fjard to arrive at Somesville. Travel east to Great Cranberry Island, Islesford, Sutton Island, and East Bunker Ledge where seals are often seen. Mansell Boat Rental Company has a few motorboats to choose from. Let us know what your needs are. Cash or personal check preferred VISA or MasterCard accepted ** all prices subject to change without notice **
